correctness.rationale: Romik canonical decomposition holds pointwise for any distinct sequence. The Mallows block-order independence and stationarity are justified by inversion-factor separation and by Crane–DeSalvo–Elizalde. All six local probabilities are exact enumerations on 2–5 ranks; second moments reduce to 2-dependent overlap. Independently derived symbolic identities give finite n variance nV+K, its derivative and reciprocity. Descartes plus P(0)>0>P(1) and leading positivity yields exactly two distinct positive reciprocal roots; derivative signs and endpoint limits prove precisely two global maxima. Independent DP enumeration across all permutations through eight symbols and symbolic checks passed 110,195 exact assertions. Limits: finite experiments are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The exact q=1 law, Romik local-extrema decomposition, and Mallows weak-dissociation tools are already established, not new. Primary text comparison with the strongest available prior works did not identify the nonuniform combined turning-point variance V(q) or exact reciprocal pair of global maxima. Their derivation requires new cross-pattern overlap enumeration and degree-ten stationary classification. Historical implicit coverage remains possible; no independence or comprehensive novelty certificate is claimed.
residual_risks: Generic Mallows and inversion-refined alternating-run formulas in earlier combinatorial literature could imply the rational variance without using the same notation.
Later work not identified in the bounded search might give an equivalent variance extremizer classification.
The existence of readily reusable covariance machinery limits the strength of the novelty claim to the explicit combined statistic and sharp optimizer analysis.

value.rationale: The Mallows ranking concentration parameter and longest alternating subsequence are independently natural statistical objects. The result proves a genuine reversal: leading mean oscillation density is uniquely maximal at uniform q=1 while leading variance is locally minimal there and attains its only global maxima at two off-uniform reciprocal q. It supplies exact finite-sample variance and a full global parameter classification, rather than a small arbitrary case or a routine q=1 recomputation.
